summary: Writing materials; interviewer comments on many New Orleans musicians still in California.

blocks.x: You got a pencil? Uh, I'll cut... Yeah, I'll cut it. Here, I mean... Do you have the paper?
Yeah, there are many musicians from New Orleans still living in California. Yeah.
This boy came out, this boy started playing our thing. You got a pencil?
Yeah, I'll cut it. Here, I need... Do you have the paper? Yeah, there are many musicians from New Orleans still living in California.
Yeah. I can't call them all. Somebody said Punch is still living.
Kid Punch, I saw him in New Orleans last week. He's still playing good and singing beautiful. Yeah.
Well, I never could hardly get home with no money.
